commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin work/photomap-straighten-20260912
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "96d849bdbdafd656783d0be78f4510852ca0d0b7"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)" = "96d849bdbdafd656783d0be78f4510852ca0d0b7"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
npm run build >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import gzip, json
p=next(Path('dist/assets').glob('public-map-*.js'))
data=p.read_bytes()
Path('/tmp/photomap-public-map-before.json').write_text(json.dumps({'raw':len(data),'gzip':len(gzip.compress(data,mtime=0))}))
PY
cd ..
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";', 'import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";', 1)
s=s.replace('import { PhotoDetailModal } from "./PhotoDetailModal";\n', '', 1)
anchor='const EMPTY_PLACE_GALLERY_ITEMS: PlaceMapVisualItem[] = [];\n'
s=s.replace(anchor, 'const LazyPhotoDetailModal = lazy(() => import("./PhotoDetailModal").then((module) => ({ default: module.PhotoDetailModal })));\n\n'+anchor, 1)
s=s.replace('{detailItem && detailPlace ? (\n        <PhotoDetailModal', '{detailItem && detailPlace ? (\n        <Suspense fallback={null}>\n          <LazyPhotoDetailModal', 1)
s=s.replace('''          onClose={() => {
            setVisualDetail(null);
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
      <ReportSheet''', '''          onClose={() => {
            setVisualDetail(null);
          }}
          />
        </Suspense>
      ) : null}
      <ReportSheet''', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import gzip, json
before=json.loads(Path('/tmp/photomap-public-map-before.json').read_text())
p=next(Path('dist/assets').glob('public-map-*.js'))
data=p.read_bytes()
after={'raw':len(data),'gzip':len(gzip.compress(data,mtime=0))}
print('public_map_before='+json.dumps(before,sort_keys=True))
print('public_map_after='+json.dumps(after,sort_keys=True))
print('public_map_delta_gzip='+str(after['gzip']-before['gzip']))
if before['gzip']-after['gzip'] < 4000:
    raise SystemExit('gzip reduction below 4KB threshold')
PY
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-photo-detail-e2e-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/map.spec.ts e2e/visual/map-gallery-sizing.spec.ts e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
git diff --check
git add frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
git commit -m 'Lazy load photo detail modal'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-straighten-20260912
printf 'published_sha=' && git rev-parse HEAD
